title: intent search reports every hit at line 0 and repeats one file per match, so a result set cannot be navigated
body:
`intent search` reports every hit at line 0 and repeats one file per hit, so a result set cannot be navigated.

DRIVEN, 2026-08-31, against a854d7c3. `intent/st/ST0056/design.md` contains the
phrase `rmcp (official SDK)` exactly once:

  $ intent search 'official SDK'
  intent/st/ST0056/design.md:0  ST0056  design.md
  intent/st/ST0056/design.md:0  ST0056  design.md
  intent/st/ST0056/design.md:0  ST0056  design.md
  intent/st/ST0056/design.md:0  ST0056  design.md

Two things are wrong and they are independent.

THE LINE NUMBER IS ALWAYS 0. `path:0` is the shape of a `file:line` reference,
so it reads as a location and is not one -- an editor or a jump-to-line consumer
lands at the top of the file every time. A column that always holds the same
value carries no information while occupying the position a reader trusts most.

THE SAME FILE REPEATS ONCE PER MATCH WITH NOTHING TO DISTINGUISH THE ROWS. Four
identical lines are indistinguishable from one match reported four times, or
from four matches whose locations were lost. dc measured 18 identical rows for
one file on a canon term. Either the rows should carry the distinct locations
they represent, or they should be collapsed to one row per file with a count.

Reported alongside the FTS5 escaping defect, which is filed separately: that one
refuses queries, this one answers them uselessly, and they have different fixes.
Found by dc while driving `docs/getting-started.md` for AC-02.1.
